title: Write integration test for rocket init
description: Create an integration test that calls createAgentStructure() against a temp directory and verifies all expected files and directories are created with the correct content.
acceptanceCriteria: Integration test creates a temp directory and calls createAgentStructure
Test verifies .agent/PROMPT.md is created with correct content
Test verifies .agent/tasks.json is created as valid JSON
Integration test passes with npm test

steps.details: Create the test file. Import createAgentStructure from agent-init.ts. Import fs, path, os from Node.js.
Use beforeEach: tmpDir = await mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'rocket-test-')). Use afterEach: await rm(tmpDir, { recursive: true }).

it('creates all .agent/ files', async () => { await createAgentStructure(tmpDir); const agentDir = path.join(tmpDir, '.agent'); await expect(fs.pathExists(path.join(agentDir, 'prd/PRD.md'))).resolves.toBe(true); // ... check all other files; const tasksJson = await fs.readJson(path.join(agentDir, 'tasks.json')); expect(tasksJson).toHaveProperty('tasks'); })

Call createAgentStructure twice. Add a file to verify it wasn't overwritten: `await fs.writeFile(path.join(agentDir, 'prd/PRD.md'), 'custom content'); await createAgentStructure(tmpDir); const content = await fs.readFile(path.join(agentDir, 'prd/PRD.md'), 'utf-8'); expect(content).toBe('custom content')`
Run `npm test` and verify the integration tests pass.
